name: @playliquid/community
description: PlayLiquid GameOS community contribution service (PL-032). Typed contribution records over the architecture's §Community vocabulary with full provenance chains — contributor subject (platform-identity vocabulary via the platform-contracts branded primitives and a SubjectDirectory seam), origin lineage (git-lineage LineageNode vocabulary, referenced not re-implemented) and content digests (package-system computeDigest, the single digest authority). Contribution state machine submitted→triaged→under-review→accepted/rejected/withdrawn with authority-stamped append-only transition history (E10) and content-addressed idempotency receipts; R18 typed capability-gap linkage through a read-only GapDirectory seam (the Lab owns the ladder); E8 trust model: third-party contributions are untrusted until qualified at accept. Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner; persistence, time, identity, Lab gap facts and package-registry qualification live behind ports with deterministic in-memory fakes; no IO, no timers, no globals.
